2608.30405.title: Dense Clinical Contrasts Enhance Medical Knowledge Updating in Large Language Models
2608.30405.paper_summary: Medical knowledge changes continually, making large language models vulnerable to relying on outdated yet clinically plausible information. We study whether the format of supervision affects medical knowledge updating under a matched training-budget setting. We introduce SEER-Bench, a temporally anchored oncology-staging benchmark curated from the latest versioned SEER Research Data release, and render identical medical update events from NCCN oncology guidelines into four supervision formats: EMQ, MSQ, FITB, and SAQ. Across SEER-Bench and HealthBench Professional, EMQ gives the most stable external transfer and retention among same-budget SFT variants. With EMQ supervision, the updated 4B model produces competitive results on temporally anchored oncology staging, reaching 64.8% answer accuracy and 59.6% rationale accuracy on SEER-Bench. Diagnostic analyses suggest that EMQ exposes denser clinical contrast signals while preserving discriminative representations with smaller movement from the base model. These results show that medical knowledge updating depends not only on the update algorithm, but also on how knowledge is structured as supervision.
2608.30405.paper_summary_zh: 醫學知識不斷變化，使得大型語言模型容易依賴過時但臨床上合理的信息。我們研究監督格式是否會影響在匹配訓練預算設置下的醫學知識更新。我們介紹了SEER-Bench，這是一個基於時間的腫瘤學分期基準，來自最新版本的SEER研究數據發布，並將NCCN腫瘤學指南中的相同醫學更新事件轉換為四種監督格式：EMQ、MSQ、FITB和SAQ。在SEER-Bench和HealthBench Professional中，EMQ在相同預算的SFT變體中提供了最穩定的外部轉移和保留。使用EMQ監督，更新的4B模型在基於時間的腫瘤學分期上產生了具有競爭力的結果，在SEER-Bench上達到了64.8%的答案準確率和59.6%的推理準確率。診斷分析表明，EMQ揭示了更密集的臨床對比信號，同時保持了較小的基模型變動下的區分性表示。這些結果顯示，醫學知識更新不僅依賴於更新算法，還依賴於知識作為監督的結構。
